name: Les Wexner
current_role: Founder and chairman emeritus of L Brands (now Bath & Body Works); philanthropist (The Wexner Foundation)
summary: Les Wexner founded The Limited in 1963 and built it into L Brands, owner of Victoria’s Secret and Bath & Body Works, which he led until 2020. A longtime Republican megadonor in Ohio, he left the party in 2018 over Trump and has since given to both sides. Jeffrey Epstein was his money manager with power of attorney from 1991 until, by Wexner’s account, he cut him off in 2007; in a February 2026 House Oversight deposition he said he had been “duped by a world-class con man” and knew nothing of Epstein’s crimes. He has not been charged with any crime.

connections.name: Jeffrey Epstein
connections.description: Epstein was Wexner’s money manager, with power of attorney from 1991; Wexner says he revoked it and cut Epstein off in September 2007 after learning he was “an abuser, a crook, and a liar,” and that Epstein took vast sums from him (reported as $46 million). Axios reported a 2008 email between them; Wexner was deposed by the House Oversight Committee in February 2026 and has not been charged.
